title: Buy it in ChatGPT: Instant Checkout and the Agentic Commerce Protocol
summary: We’re taking first steps toward agentic commerce in ChatGPT with new ways for people, AI agents, and businesses to shop together.
body: We’re taking first steps toward agentic commerce in ChatGPT with new ways for people, AI agents, and businesses to shop together.
summaryZh: OpenAI在ChatGPT中迈出了智能体商业化的第一步，引入了即时结账功能以及智能体商业协议，探索人类、AI智能体与企业共同购物的新协作方式。原始信息显示：We’re taking first steps toward agentic commerce in ChatGPT with new ways for people, AI agents, and businesses to shop together.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Buy it in ChatGPT: Instant Checkout and the Agentic Commerce Protocol”。其重要性主要体现在：文章涉及AI智能体在商业领域的实际应用和协议探索，对了解智能体技术生态具有重要参考价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
